name: 2019-1c-recuperatorio-extendido
title: Fast Food Store Working Hours (extended)
description: Extended variant of the working-hours exam: employees register weekly availability as a weekday range or per-weekday slots (weeks must start on Monday, hours on the dot and within 7:00-23:00), sheets answer whether an employee works at a date-time, and the store reports both the uncovered hourly slots of a week and the employees working less than 40 hours. The student must build the model from scratch with TDD.

design.notes: Same polymorphic working-hours design as the base exam plus validated creation (Monday start, whole hours, 7-23 range) and a second store query that sums hours per employee with inject: and filters with select:, which rewards a working-hours abstraction that knows its own duration.
